title: Attendance Policy
aliases: how much attendance do I need
what happens if my attendance is short
minimum attendance to sit for exams
content: VIT-AP's specific minimum attendance percentage and exemption rules are not published in detail on the public VIT-AP website. The official Policies page lists formal university policy documents, but no separate public attendance policy PDF was found there as of the last check. For the exact current attendance requirement, check your programme handbook, the VTOP student portal, or ask your faculty advisor or the Centre of Examinations.
